name: ecuc-virtualized-render-search
title: ECUC virtualized rendering and search/filter engine
description: Replace the full ECUC tree DOM render with a flattened visible-row model and a windowed virtual renderer, and add an indexed/debounced filter engine over the same rows. Preserve the quiet-source and Tree presentations, editing/navigation/collapse/selection/state, accessibility and the no-core/write/dependency contracts; target large/huge load and filter responsiveness.
creator: deviousprophet
